value.rationale: A complete necessary-and-sufficient positivity admissibility law for a natural all-even-mesh family enables sharp positive-data robustness choices in optimal kernel cubature. It proves actual failure via nonnegative polynomial integrands and reveals a nontrivial N versus N^4 separation that makes the constant-function positivity test misleading. The exact parameter boundary and structural hat-plus-common-offset mechanism go beyond a routine single-mesh computation.
